title: Quick Saudi Arabian Tomato Bake
description: A dense and flavorful Saudi Arabian dish featuring tomatoes, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with no onions or garlic, and a hint of winey taste from the tomatoes and spices.

ingredients.name: canned crushed tomatoes
ingredients.notes: san marzano or other fresh tasting brand

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the tomato paste, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes and water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the mixture is hot and the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
